## About
Boulevard Radiator Hospital is a family owned and operated radiator shop in Pembroke Pines, serving drivers and fleets across Broward and Dade counties.
Radiators are what we know best. We clean, flush and overhaul them on everything from a daily driver to heavy duty trucks and industrial equipment, and we also repair and reline fuel tanks, service A/C condensers and oil coolers, and restore cloudy headlights.
Our work is done right here on site. If you need a new radiator, A/C condenser or fuel tank, give us a call.

## Services
- Car radiators: Cleaning, repair, service and replacement for car radiators.
- Heavy duty and truck radiators: Cleaning, repair, service and replacement for truck and heavy duty radiators.
- Industrial and fleet radiators: Cleaning, repair, service and replacement for industrial and fleet radiators.
- Fuel tanks: We clean, repair, inner coat, outer coat and rebuild fuel tanks, and we can reline rusty ones.
- A/C condensers: Cleaning, repair and replacement of A/C condensers.
- Air coolers: We charge, clean, repair and replace air coolers.
- Oil coolers: Cleaning and repair of oil coolers.
- Headlight restoration: We wet sand the cloudy, discolored UV layer off your headlights and reseal them with a new layer of UV protection.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on trucks and industrial equipment?
A: Yes. We clean, flush and overhaul radiators on cars, trucks, heavy duty and industrial equipment.

Q: Can you fix a rusty gas tank?
A: Yes. Along with cleaning and repair, we can coat or reline rusty fuel tanks.

Q: Can I buy a new radiator from you?
A: Yes. If you need a new radiator, A/C condenser or fuel tank, give us a call.
